name: AR_CUST_PARTY_PROFILE_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer party.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer account number of the customer party specified on the Receivables transaction.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TYPE
columns.description: User-defined code for the customer type. Values are derived from the lookup code CUSTOMER_TYPE.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer account created for a customer party.

columns.name: CUST_GLOBAL_ATTR1
columns.description: Segment of the customer party profile global descriptive fliexfield 1.

columns.name: CUST_GLOBAL_ATTR10
columns.description: Segment of the customer party profile global descriptive fliexfield 10.

columns.name: CUST_GLOBAL_ATTR12
columns.description: Segment of the customer party profile global descriptive fliexfield 12.

columns.name: CUST_GLOBAL_ATTR9
columns.description: Segment of the customer party profile global descriptive fliexfield 9.

columns.name: CUST_GLOBAL_ATTR_CAT
columns.description: Structure definition of the customer party profile global descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: NPA_NUMBER
columns.description: Number plan area (NPA) number, or area code, of the customer account phone number.

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: User-defined category code of the customer. Values are derived from the lookup type CUSTOMER_CATEGORY.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City of the customer identifying address.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Country of the customer identifying address. Country codes are listed in the TERRITORY_CODE column of the FND_TERRITORY table.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: County of the customer identifying address.

columns.name: GROUP_TYPE
columns.description: User-defined code of the customer group type.  Values are derived from the lookup code GROUP_TYPE.

columns.name: GSA_INDICATOR_FLAG
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the customer party is a US federal agency supported by the General Services Administration (GSA). Valid values are: Y for organizations served by the GSA; N for organizations that are not served by the GSA.

columns.name: JGZZ_FISCAL_CODE
columns.description: Taxpayer identification number of the customer party.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer party specified on the Receivables transaction.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the customer party specified on the Receivables transaction.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Party type of the customer party. Valid values are: Person, Organization, Group.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code of the customer identifying address.

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: Province of the customer identifying address.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State of the customer identifying address.

columns.name: TAX_REFERENCE
columns.description: Tax reference of the customer party.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Customer class identifier of the customer party. For example, an account created for a reseller or educational customer has a customer class code of reseller or education.
